id: 22_Verification of KVL and KCL Using Virtual Lab IIT Kharagpur Demonstration Basic
title: 在线仿真验证基尔霍夫定律（国内版）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/22_Verification of KVL and KCL Using Virtual Lab IIT Kharagpur Demonstration Basic.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/22_Verification of KVL and KCL Using Virtual Lab IIT Kharagpur Demonstration Basic（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 电压定律、电流定律分开做
points.K7: 电压定律：接电源和电压表
points.K12: 电流定律：电流表要串联
points.K16: 存档评价，用教材数值验证
points.S1: 仿真接错能重来，真电路不行
points.S2: 先仿真预演，再上台实操
points.S3: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在笔记本电脑前，屏幕上是空白的电路仿真界面图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits at a laptop whose screen shows only a simple circuit icon, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 大家好！今天用电脑做电路实验。
overlay: 在线仿真验证基尔霍夫定律

shots.scene: 电脑、电路图标、电压表电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a laptop, a circuit diagram, and a pair of meters. No people.
shots.narration: 在线仿真，验证电压定律和电流定律。

shots.scene: 阿杰在宿舍抱着笔记本，课本上画着电路
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits in his dorm with a laptop and an open textbook showing a circuit icon.
shots.narration: 实验课前，阿杰想先在电脑上练练。

shots.scene: 小研凑过来指着屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leans over and points at his laptop screen.
shots.narration: 小研说：有在线仿真，跟着做就行。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上一个空白搜索框和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A laptop screen with a blank search box and a magnifier icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先在浏览器里搜索基尔霍夫定律仿真。

shots.scene: 搜索结果列表，一项被点击高亮
shots.prompt_en: A list of blank search result bars with one highlighted as clicked. No people.
shots.narration: 点进验证基尔霍夫定律的实验页。

shots.section_title: 电压定律、电流定律分开做
shots.scene: 屏幕上两个大按钮图标：电压箭头和电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A screen with two large buttons, one with a voltage arrow icon and one with a current arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电压定律和电流定律，分开验证。
overlay: 电压定律、电流定律分开做

shots.section_title: 电压定律、电流定律分开做
shots.scene: 鼠标指针点在电压按钮上
shots.prompt_en: A mouse pointer clicks the voltage arrow button. No people.
shots.narration: 先做电压定律。

shots.scene: 仿真界面：电源、三块电压表、电路板，左侧说明栏
shots.prompt_en: A simulation screen showing a power supply, three voltmeters with blank dials, a circuit board, and an instruction panel on the left. No people.
shots.narration: 界面里，电源、电表、电路都备好了。

shots.scene: 鼠标拖出一根导线连到节点
shots.prompt_en: A mouse pointer drags a wire from a terminal to a node on the circuit. No people.
shots.narration: 用鼠标拖动节点，就能连线。

shots.scene: 电压表并联在电阻两端的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a voltmeter connected across a resistor. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：电压表并联在元件两端。

shots.scene: 页面侧边菜单一列空白条目图标
shots.prompt_en: A side menu with a column of blank entries with small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 页面有一排栏目。

shots.scene: 目的页：一个靶心图标和几行空白
shots.prompt_en: An aim page with a target icon and blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 目的：用定律求支路电压电流，和理论比。

shots.scene: 原理页：电路图和求和符号
shots.prompt_en: A theory page with a circuit diagram and a summation symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 原理页有电压定律推导和电流定律公式。

shots.scene: 预习测试页：几个选择题方框
shots.prompt_en: A pretest page with several blank multiple-choice boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 先做预习测试，检查基础打牢没有。

shots.scene: 步骤页：编号步骤和一张接线图
shots.prompt_en: A procedure page with numbered steps and a wiring diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 步骤页配着接线图，一看就懂。

shots.section_title: 电压定律：接电源和电压表
shots.scene: 电源正负端分别连到电路正负端
shots.prompt_en: A power supply's positive and negative terminals wired to the circuit's positive and negative points. No people.
shots.narration: 电源接电路：正接正，负接负。
overlay: 电压定律：接电源和电压表

shots.section_title: 电压定律：接电源和电压表
shots.scene: 第一块电压表并在 R1 两端
shots.prompt_en: The first voltmeter wired across resistor R1. No people.
shots.narration: 第一块电压表并在 R1 两端。

shots.section_title: 电压定律：接电源和电压表
shots.scene: 第二、第三块电压表分别并在 R2、R3 两端
shots.prompt_en: The second and third voltmeters wired across resistors R2 and R3. No people.
shots.narration: 另外两块分别并在 R2、R3 上。

shots.scene: 鼠标点击检查按钮
shots.prompt_en: A mouse pointer clicks a check button marked with a check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 通电前，先点检查按钮。

shots.scene: 弹出一个绿色对勾提示框
shots.prompt_en: A pop-up box with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 提示接线正确，再设定电阻值。

shots.scene: 三根滑块被拖动
shots.prompt_en: Three sliders being dragged to set values. No people.
shots.narration: 拖动滑块，设好三个电阻。

shots.scene: 鼠标点电源开关，电源显示从零开始
shots.prompt_en: A mouse pointer clicks the power button and the supply display starts at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 打开电源，电压从零开始。

shots.scene: 滑块右移，三块电压表指针跟着升高
shots.prompt_en: A voltage slider moves right and the three voltmeter needles rise together. No people.
shots.narration: 慢慢调高电压，表的读数跟着变。

shots.scene: 点添加，观察表增加一行
shots.prompt_en: A mouse pointer clicks an add button and a new row appears in the observation table. No people.
shots.narration: 每调一次，点添加，记进表格。

shots.scene: 观察表六行填满
shots.prompt_en: The observation table filled with six rows of blank values. No people.
shots.narration: 至少记六组数据。

shots.scene: 小研指着一行读数，第一块表加第二块表等于电源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at one table row, showing that two readings add up to the supply value.
shots.narration: 看一看：两段电压加起来，正好等于电源。

shots.scene: 屏幕上两条随电压上升的直线图
shots.prompt_en: A screen graph with two straight lines rising with supply voltage. No people.
shots.narration: 点绘图，得到电压变化曲线。

shots.scene: 打印预览页面和一台打印机
shots.prompt_en: A print preview page next to a printer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 点打印，结果存进实验记录。

shots.scene: 点复位，界面清空
shots.prompt_en: A mouse pointer clicks a reset button and the screen clears. No people.
shots.narration: 想重做，点复位从头来。

shots.scene: 闭合回路图标，箭头绕一圈，加减号相互抵消
shots.prompt_en: A closed loop icon with an arrow going around, plus and minus signs cancelling out. No people.
shots.narration: 结论：闭合回路电压代数和为零。

shots.scene: 电源电动势和几个电压降天平平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a battery icon on one side and several voltage drop icons on the other, level. No people.
shots.narration: 电动势之和，等于电压降之和。

shots.section_title: 电流定律：电流表要串联
shots.scene: 鼠标返回选择页，点电流按钮
shots.prompt_en: A mouse pointer returns to the selection page and clicks the current arrow button. No people.
shots.narration: 接着做电流定律。
overlay: 电流定律：电流表要串联

shots.section_title: 电流定律：电流表要串联
shots.scene: 电流表串在电阻支路中的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ammeter connected in series within a resistor branch. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表必须串联在支路里。

shots.section_title: 电流定律：电流表要串联
shots.scene: 电流表并联的图标打红叉，屏幕不工作
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ammeter wired in parallel, crossed out with a red X, the screen frozen. No people.
shots.narration: 接错了，仿真就不工作。

shots.section_title: 电流定律：电流表要串联
shots.scene: 动圈式电流表图标配直流直线
shots.prompt_en: A moving coil ammeter icon with a straight DC line. No people.
shots.narration: 直流电路，用动圈式电流表。

shots.scene: 检查按钮和绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A check button and a green check mark pop-up. No people.
shots.narration: 同样先检查接线。

shots.scene: 空白教材旁三根滑块
shots.prompt_en: Three sliders beside an open blank textbook. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻可以按教材的设计值来取。

shots.scene: 电源电压逐步调高，三块电流表读数变化
shots.prompt_en: The supply voltage steps up and three ammeter needles change. No people.
shots.narration: 调电压，记下三个支路电流。

shots.scene: 观察表六行填满，旁边一个曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: An observation table with six filled rows beside a graph icon. No people.
shots.narration: 最多记六组，也可以绘图。

shots.scene: 一个节点，一支电流流入，两支流出
shots.prompt_en: A junction icon with one current arrow flowing in and two flowing out. No people.
shots.narration: 结论：总电流等于两支路电流之和。

shots.scene: 流入和流出箭头天平平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with incoming arrows on one side and outgoing arrows on the other, level. No people.
shots.narration: 流入节点的，等于流出节点的。

shots.scene: 两个读数近似相等的约等号
shots.prompt_en: Two blank value cards with an approximately-equal sign. No people.
shots.narration: 有一点偏差，属于正常。

shots.section_title: 存档评价，用教材数值验证
shots.scene: 打印好的实验结果交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a printed result sheet with only icons to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 打印存档，方便老师评价。
overlay: 存档评价，用教材数值验证

shots.section_title: 存档评价，用教材数值验证
shots.scene: 教材电路和仿真电路并排对照
shots.prompt_en: A textbook circuit and the simulation circuit side by side for comparison. No people.
shots.narration: 用教材上的数值验证，更有说服力。

shots.scene: 王老师在讲台用投影演示仿真，学生观看
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator demonstrates the simulation on a projector screen with only circuit icons while students watch.
shots.narration: 课堂演示仿真，帮学生理解原理。

shots.section_title: 仿真接错能重来，真电路不行
shots.scene: 仿真屏幕弹出错误提示，旁边一个复位箭头
shots.prompt_en: A simulation screen showing a warning pop-up, beside a reset arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 仿真里接错，弹个提示就能重来。
overlay: 仿真接错能重来，真电路不行

shots.section_title: 仿真接错能重来，真电路不行
shots.scene: 真实电流表接错冒烟的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a real ammeter wired wrongly with a puff of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 真电路接错，可能烧表、短路。

shots.section_title: 仿真接错能重来，真电路不行
shots.scene: 王老师在真实实验台前给阿杰讲安全规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains the safety rules to the young male student at a real lab bench.
shots.narration: 会做仿真，也要先过安全培训。

shots.section_title: 先仿真预演，再上台实操
shots.scene: 阿杰先在电脑上连好线，再对照着在实验台上接线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student first wires the circuit on a laptop, then wires the real bench while comparing with the screen.
shots.narration: 先在仿真里把线路走一遍。
overlay: 先仿真预演，再上台实操

shots.section_title: 先仿真预演，再上台实操
shots.scene: 空白笔记本上画着接线图和预估读数方框
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook with a wiring sketch and blank boxes for expected readings.
shots.narration: 预估读数大小，选好量程。

shots.section_title: 先仿真预演，再上台实操
shots.scene: 王老师检查阿杰的实物接线后点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the young male student's real wiring and nods.
shots.narration: 实物接好，照样请老师检查再通电。

shots.section_title: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关
shots.scene: 实验室灯突然熄灭，台面仪表也黑了
shots.prompt_en: The lab lights suddenly go out and the bench instruments go dark.
shots.narration: 做实验时，突然停电了。
overlay: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关

shots.section_title: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关
shots.scene: 阿杰拉下实验台电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power switch in the dim room.
shots.narration: 先把实验台的电源开关断开。

shots.section_title: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关
shots.scene: 来电时电机突然启动的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a motor suddenly starting when power returns, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免得来电时设备突然启动。

shots.section_title: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关
shots.scene: 老周来电后检查线路，再让大家合闸
shots.prompt_en: After power returns, the older man checks the benches before letting students switch on again.
shots.narration: 来电后，检查无误再重新合闸。

shots.scene: 配电箱前堆着纸箱的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of cardboard boxes piled in front of a distribution box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 配电箱前，不能堆放杂物。

shots.scene: 老李把纸箱搬开，配电箱前留出空地
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves boxes away, leaving clear space in front of the distribution box.
shots.narration: 出事时，要能马上拉闸断电。

shots.scene: 通道畅通，墙上有安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: A clear lab aisle with an exit sign on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 疏散通道也要保持畅通。

shots.scene: 电压表并联、电流表串联两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a voltmeter in parallel and an ammeter in series. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表并联，电流表串联。

shots.scene: 回路求和为零、节点流入等于流出两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a loop with a sum equal to zero, and a junction with in equals out. No people.
shots.narration: 回路电压和为零，节点流入等于流出。

shots.scene: 检查、添加、绘图、打印、复位五个按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: Five button icons in a row: check, add, plot, print, reset. No people.
shots.narration: 先检查，再记录，绘图打印存档。

shots.scene: 电脑和真实实验台之间一个箭头，旁边断电开关和配电箱
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a laptop to a real lab bench, beside a switched-off switch and a clear distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 仿真不代替实操；停电断开关，箱前不堆物。

shots.scene: 欣欣合上笔记本，站到真实实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes the laptop and waves goodbye in front of a real, switched-off lab bench.
shots.narration: 下次实验课见，安全用电！
